verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that POS inventory syncs in real time across POS, the online store and every sales channel, at every location. They also cover Quick counts with barcode scanners, receiving shipments, and exchanges that update inventory instantly, run from a centralized back office scaling to 1,000+ locations. One older community report of an integer-overflow bug breaking inventory counts, and an old complaint about missing custom product fields, are isolated rather than a concrete refutation of sync. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of catalog management itself (creating and editing products and variants), and independent hands-on corroboration that counts stay in sync across registers.
